items.distractor_fact: Doma měřený teploměr ve stejnou dobu ukazoval hodnotu {D} °C.
items.gloss_en: A thermometer measured at home showed a reading of D°C at the same time (unit symbol directly after the number keeps this invariant for any integer).
items.entity_note: owner is a personal instrument (a home thermometer), not a place, unlike the first distractor's neighboring weather station

items.distractor_fact: Jiný investor ten den nakoupil akcie za {D} Kč.
items.gloss_en: Another investor bought shares for D Kč that same day ("za D Kč", unit symbol after the number, invariant for any integer).
items.entity_note: owner is an individual person (another investor), not an organisation, unlike the first distractor's other company

items.distractor_fact: Vodohospodářský podnik, který provozuje jinou nádrž, ohlásil ve stejnou dobu úroveň {D} m.
items.gloss_en: The water-management company that operates a different reservoir reported a level of D m at the same time ("úroveň D m", unit symbol after the number, invariant).
items.entity_note: owner is an organisation (the utility company), not a place, unlike the first distractor which named the other reservoir itself

items.distractor_fact: Jiný turista ve stejný den vystoupal do výšky {D} m.
items.gloss_en: Another hiker climbed to an altitude of D m on the same day ("do výšky D m", unit symbol after the number, invariant).
items.entity_note: owner is a person (another hiker), not a place, unlike the first distractor's neighboring peak

items.distractor_fact: Jiný klient téže banky ten den vložil na svůj účet {D} €.
items.gloss_en: Another client of the same bank deposited D euros into his account that day (unit symbol after the number, invariant).
items.entity_note: owner is a person (another client), not the account/instrument itself, unlike the first distractor's other account

items.distractor_fact: Jednotlivý podnikatel v tomtéž odvětví měl za tentýž měsíc příjmy {D} €.
items.gloss_en: A sole trader in the same industry had revenue of D euros for the same month (unit symbol after the number, invariant).
items.entity_note: owner is an individual person (a sole trader), not a company, unlike the first distractor's other firm

items.distractor_fact: Nejlepší střelec soutěže vstřelil za sezónu branky v počtu {D}.
items.gloss_en: The competition's top scorer scored a number of D goals for the season ("branky v počtu D", the story's own fixed count-phrase, invariant for any integer, avoiding numeral-noun agreement).
items.entity_note: owner is a person (an individual player), not a team, unlike the first distractor's other team in the league

items.distractor_fact: Investiční fond ve stejném roce vykázal zisky ve výši {D} €.
items.gloss_en: An investment fund reported profits of D euros for the same year ("ve výši D €", the story's own fixed amount-phrase, invariant).
items.entity_note: owner is an organisation (a fund), not a person, unlike the first distractor's other individual investor

items.distractor_fact: Automatizovaná výrobní linka mimo tento koncern vyrobila ve stejném měsíci {D} ks jiného výrobku.
items.gloss_en: An automated production line outside this concern produced D units of a different product that same month (unit symbol "ks" after the number, invariant), and its own output is not measured against this story's plan.
items.entity_note: owner is a piece of equipment (a production line), not a factory/organisation, unlike the first distractor's other factory in the same concern

items.distractor_fact: Franšízant provozující nezávislou prodejnu téže značky dosáhl ve stejném měsíci tržeb {D} €.
items.gloss_en: A franchisee running an independently owned store of the same brand achieved revenue of D euros that same month (unit symbol after the number, invariant); this franchisee's own store has no stated sales target here.
items.entity_note: owner is a person (a franchisee-operator), not a store/organisation, unlike the first distractor's other store in the same chain

items.distractor_fact: Meteorologický ústav v sousední zemi zaznamenal za týž měsíc úhrn srážek {D} mm.
items.gloss_en: The meteorological institute in a neighboring country recorded total rainfall of D mm for the same month (unit symbol after the number, invariant), with no forecast of its own stated here.
items.entity_note: owner is an organisation (a meteorological institute), not a place/region, unlike the first distractor's neighboring region

items.distractor_fact: Jiný dopravce provozující autobusovou linku na téže trase vypravil skutečný odjezd v čase odpovídajícím {D} min od půlnoci.
items.gloss_en: A different operator running a bus line on the same route dispatched an actual departure at a time corresponding to D minutes past midnight ("v čase odpovídajícím D min od půlnoci", the story's own fixed clock-phrase, invariant); this operator's own timetable is not the one given in the story.
items.entity_note: owner is an organisation (a different transport operator), not another train/instrument, unlike the first distractor's other train on another line

items.distractor_fact: Technik při kontrole jiného výtahu zaznamenal zastavení v podlaží s označením {D}.
items.gloss_en: A technician inspecting a different elevator recorded it stopping at a floor labeled D ("s označením D", the story's own fixed label-phrase, invariant); that elevator's floor labeling has its own, unstated ground-floor reference.
items.entity_note: owner is a person (a technician reporting on another elevator), not a building/place, unlike the first distractor's elevator in a neighboring building
